title: Supply-Continuity Bonus, Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal Loyalty Credit
content:
The renewal loyalty credit of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement rewards a year of steady supply. The energy lines posted on the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date are counted; 12 or more add 20.00 dollars; 6 to 11 add 10.00 dollars; fewer than 6 add nothing.

**Which lines are counted?**
The energy charge lines of the renewed agreement only; a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date. Service fee, sales tax, fee and credit lines are not energy lines.

**What does each count earn?**
Twelve or more lines earn 20.00 USD; six to eleven lines earn 10.00 USD; five lines or fewer earn nothing.

**Where are the edges?**
Five lines earn nothing and six earn 10.00 USD; eleven lines earn 10.00 USD and twelve earn 20.00 USD.

**A hypothetical site whose supply started eight months before the handling date, with one energy line per cycle since?**
It carries 8 energy lines in the window and adds 10.00 USD.
